cards.p: An order costs $8.00 against the $10.00 you can afford, so each leaves $2.00. Over 30 days that is 74 × $2.00 = $148.00 of profit, earned while the campaign sat out of budget every afternoon.
Five orders' worth is 5 × 12.5 = 62.5, so 63 clicks. Below that you have a number, not a reading.
On a $20.00 daily budget in a 30-day month, the month is capped at $20.00 × 30 = $600.00 either way. At the 25% setting one day may reach $25.00; at the 100% setting, $40.00.
You cannot tell a keyword converting at 4% from one converting at 12% on 15 clicks. You paid $12.00 for that keyword's month and learned nothing.
